summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，显示书名《爱打扮的豹先生》及其拼音注释，背景为橙黄色。

title_en: Mr. Leopard Loves to Dress Up
page_text_ocr_zh:
爱打扮的豹先生是很凶残的，无论谁到了他的爪子底下，都别想逃命。
这天，豹先生把身上的毛梳理得溜光，穿上漂亮的外套，还打上一个黑色的领结，完全像一位高贵的绅士。
他在森林里慢条斯理地走着，谁看见他都躲得远远的。对于没有谁敢来欣赏他的美丽，豹先生深感遗憾。
page_text_en:
Mr. Leopard, who loves to dress up, is very fierce. Whoever gets under his claws can't escape.
Today, Mr. Leopard combed his fur until it shone, put on a beautiful coat, and tied a black bow tie, looking just like a noble gentleman.
He walked slowly and elegantly through the forest. Everyone who saw him ran away. Because no one dared to come and admire his beauty, Mr. Leopard felt deeply disappointed.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了爱打扮的豹先生虽然外表高贵，但因凶残而无人敢靠近，他为此感到遗憾。

title_en: Mr. Leopard Loves to Dress Up
page_text_ocr_zh:

page_text_en:
What a mess! A little rabbit was chatting with
a little squirrel, and they were so engrossed that
when Mr. Leopard's paw landed on the rabbit's shoulder,
the rabbit even pushed Mr. Leopard's paw
and said: "Don't joke around!"

When the little rabbit
looked back and saw Mr. Leopard,
he naturally understood
this couldn't be a joke. The little
squirrel, however, was so scared
that it climbed up the tree.
summary_zh: 豹先生突然靠近正在聊天的小兔子和小松鼠，小兔子推开了他的爪子并警告他别开玩笑，小松鼠则吓得爬上了树。

title_en: Mr. Leopard Loves to Dress Up
page_text_ocr_zh:
小兔子哆嗦了一下，反倒镇静了。
“豹先生，您好！看到您打扮得这么高贵，我很高兴。”小兔子从头到脚打量了一下豹先生说，“能给这样的豹先生充饥，我感到很有意义。”
豹先生听了哈哈大笑，得意极了。
“不过，”小兔子接着说，“你在吃我的时候，会把衣服弄脏的，这不挺可惜的吗？”
“对，我得把新衣服脱下来。”豹先生自言自语。
“当然，你脱吧！我不会跑的，我怎么跑得过你呢？”小兔子说。
豹先生觉得小兔子说得对，比赛跑，小兔子可不是他的对手。
page_text_en:
The little rabbit trembled a bit, but then calmed down.
"Mr. Leopard, hello! Seeing you dressed so elegantly, I'm very happy," the little rabbit said, looking Mr. Leopard up and down. "Feeding such a Mr. Leopard would be very meaningful to me."
Mr. Leopard laughed heartily and felt extremely pleased.
"But," the little rabbit continued, "when you eat me, you'll get your clothes dirty. Isn't that a bit of a shame?"
"Right, I'll have to take off my new clothes," Mr. Leopard muttered to himself.
"Of course, go ahead and take them off! I won't run away. How could I possibly run faster than you?" said the little rabbit.
Mr. Leopard thought the little rabbit was right—when it came to racing, the little rabbit certainly wasn't his match.
summary_zh: 小兔子面对豹先生的威胁，冷静应对，提出要他脱下新衣服再吃自己，豹先生觉得有道理并自言自语要脱衣服，小兔子则表示自己跑不过他，豹先生因此认为比赛跑自己是胜者。

title_en: Mr. Leopard Loves to Dress Up
page_text_ocr_zh:
豹先生一听，急忙跑回来穿上衣服，戴上领结。然后，再去追赶小兔子。
小兔子呢？早就没影了。
page_text_en:
Mr. Leopard, upon hearing this, hurried back, put on his clothes, and tied his bowtie. Then, he went to chase after the little rabbit.
Where is the little rabbit? He's long gone.
summary_zh: 豹先生脱下衣服追赶小兔子，但小兔子早已逃跑，他追到后发现小兔子不见了。
